jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game pickup: ONE complete beverage can on transparent background, upright front three-quarter very slight view, full can and silver rims visible, centered with padding. Create a new MAGIC DRINK flavor named POPCORN PANIC. Reference image is family STYLE only, not an edit target. Same bright hand-inked illustrated aluminum soda can, bold thick dark contours, glossy painterly highlights and legible lettering. Rich plum-magenta label with caramel-gold and cream accents. Cute excited caramel popcorn kernel mascot with little witch hat and star wand, surrounded by bursting popped corn, golden corn seeds and small candy pieces. Exact large central words MAGIC DRINK; below smaller exact flavor POPCORN PANIC. Distinct from honey mango; no bees, mangoes or honeycomb. Shape matches reference can proportions and looks like an actual collectible can. No scene, ground, shadow rectangle, borders, other text or UI. Real alpha background.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D GAME EFFECT SPRITE ATLAS, exactly FOUR columns by FOUR rows, 16 separated square cells, generous transparent gutters, all effects complete inside individual cell. Reference for hand-painted outlined glossy cartoon game FX style only. Theme: explosive MAGIC shotgun discharge of CARAMEL POPCORN and candy seeds. Not pixel art. Cream-white bright core, warm golden pressure streaks, caramel orange spark seeds, a few plum/pink candy chips, bold tapering inked contours. No weapons, people, letters, labels, numbers, grid lines or opaque background. All directional shapes face RIGHT. Rows1 and2 together are EIGHT sequential one-shot blast frames left-to-right: small compressed white-gold muzzle pop at LEFT of cell, growing short broad cone of pressure, full force wide conical blast full of kernels, extended rushing cone, breaking cloud of popcorn, softer expanding dust and tumbling kernels, few fading streaks, final caramel crumbs. Maintain SAME left origin at 12%cell width and center height across these eight frames, expansion predominantly to right. High power arcade visual, a coherent pressure cone rather than separate fireballs or flames. Row3 four individual flying projectile kernel/popped-corn cels, caramel glossy seed then popped whitecorn in alternate rotations, small tapered golden speed streak trailing LEFT; each same scale. Row4 four impact animation frames centered: crisp cream star-shaped pressure pop with kernels, wide caramel crumb burst, curling popcorn dust and sparks, dissipating crumbs. White/cream center on first impacts, no giant fire. Each cell independently transparent; do not overlap adjacent cells. A playful powerful candy shotgun effect.
